exit_criterion: Every reused idea has a source, exactly one UFT-ID claim class, explicit preserved structure, explicit not-inherited structure, and a prohibited inference.

imports.name: Canonical source versus projection
preserved_structure: canonical source remains separately identified from projections
retrieval is distinct from inference
absence is unavailable rather than automatically false
epistemic state is preserved across projection
imports.prohibited_inference: A projection or retrieval surface is not promoted to source truth or physical ontology.
imports.reason_for_reuse: Prevents derived representations from quietly replacing their evidence source.

imports.name: Receiver neutrality and non-privileged projection
preserved_structure: receiver is an explicit map
canonical event/source object is separate from receiver artifacts
no receiver is mathematically privileged
preserved and lost structure must be declared
imports.prohibited_inference: A deterministic receiver is not a uniquely natural observation of the underlying domain.
imports.reason_for_reuse: Strengthens observation-map discipline and blocks receiver-dependent results from masquerading as invariant facts.

imports.name: Multi-scale invariant preservation and deterministic receipts
not_inherited: deterministic software as evidence for deterministic universe
preserved_structure: canonical input/output identity
recompute-not-trust validation
explicit invariant checks at named boundaries
deterministic evidence receipts
runtime/release identity kept separate from scientific claim
imports.prohibited_inference: A replay-safe receipt or invariant match does not establish a physical quantum claim.
imports.reason_for_reuse: Provides auditable evidence boundaries and forces preserved invariants to be named rather than implied.

imports.name: Dark-state / observer-inaccessible specialization
not_inherited: claim that unobserved means physically destroyed
preserved_structure: internal/latent state may be distinct from observable emission
inaccessibility is observer-relative
black-box limits can be studied without declaring hidden state absent
reconstruction may fail without physical destruction
imports.prohibited_inference: Observer inaccessibility is not evidence for a hidden physical substance or anomalous causal channel.
imports.reason_for_reuse: Adds a useful observer-relative failure mode while quarantining the source's broader speculative synthesis.

imports.name: Calibration locality and provenance discipline
not_inherited: 0.42 or any other local threshold as universal constant
Wasserstein distance as universal physical cost
preserved_structure: metrics and thresholds are calibration-profile dependent
representation/ground metric/estimator choices are explicit
recalibration is a named event
numerical claims retain provenance labels
imports.prohibited_inference: A threshold or metric value measured under one calibration profile cannot be transported unchanged without a bridge.
imports.reason_for_reuse: Prevents local diagnostics from becoming universal constants through repetition or naming.

imports.name: Formal theorem != runtime result != physical validation
not_inherited: shared-world cognitive substrate as scientific ontology
preserved_structure: model output is untrusted input
consensus/telemetry/provider identity confer no epistemic authority
runtime behavior and tests are distinct from prose/formal declarations
live stochastic inference is not falsely marked replayable
imports.prohibited_inference: A proof-looking artifact, runtime success, consensus result, or telemetry record cannot be promoted across evidence layers without the required bridge.
imports.reason_for_reuse: Creates an explicit evidence ladder and blocks category errors between theorem, implementation, experiment, and physical interpretation.

imports.name: Machine-readable nonclaim and epistemic-cap surfaces
not_inherited: specific claim-tier vocabulary as universal law
preserved_structure: machine-readable epistemic states
machine-readable evidence classes and promotion caps
unknown is not false
conflict remains visible
formal syntax is not proof
receipt identity does not imply empirical truth
imports.prohibited_inference: A machine-readable claim policy constrains what may be asserted; it does not itself prove the governed scientific claim.
imports.reason_for_reuse: Makes nonclaims and evidence ceilings executable rather than relying only on human prose.
